description: Get the user's LinkedIn data changes from the past 28 days (profile edits, new connections, etc.). Poll incrementally by passing the previous response's nextStartTime. If empty, run linkedin_check_access to verify consent.

maxPages.description: Max pages of results to fetch (1–25). Each page holds ~10 records. Lower this to keep responses small.

startTime.description: Only return changes at or after this Unix timestamp in milliseconds. Omit for the most recent changes. For polling, pass the previous response's nextStartTime.

name: linkedin_get_recent_changes

apiVersion.description: LinkedIn API version used for the request.

events.description: Recent change events on the member's LinkedIn data.

nextStartTime.description: Pass this back as startTime on the next call to continue polling without duplicates.

truncated.description: True if more results exist beyond the page limit.

title: Get recent LinkedIn changes
